sources.selection: class = 'GALAXY', 0.004 ≤ z ≤ 0.15 (stratified bins); this build combines a 40,000-object low-redshift query with higher-redshift bins that completed successfully.
sources.note: Spectroscopic galaxy redshift sample. Coverage is the SDSS footprint and only part of the available redshift range; it is a shallow, incomplete slice, not a complete sky map. Positions are flat-ΛCDM comoving distances (H₀=70, Ωm=0.3), converted from RA/Dec.
